announcements.summary: £100 Household Energy Payment for eligible England council-tax bands A–D from January 2027; £2.6bn programme.
Additional £1.5bn for the Social and Affordable Housing Programme.
Your First Home equity-loan scheme: £4.7bn of government-backed lending, planned from next spring.

interpretation.forecastRevision: March-to-October headroom change combines forecast changes and policy decisions; it is not a measured Budget effect.
interpretation.withinForecast: The October pre-measures and post-measures comparison is an OBR policy costing within one forecast vintage.
interpretation.dailyMarkets: A Budget-day close versus the preceding close includes overnight and other news; it does not isolate the announcement.
interpretation.slowData: Monthly and quarterly reference periods published after Budget day can still describe pre-Budget conditions.
interpretation.composite: A recomputed headline can move because of changed data availability, baselines or calculation corrections; inspect the raw series and methodology annotations.
